doc: the community floor for build events: the keys every party in the fleet already agreed on, and not one key more.

refs.name: SubjectRef
refs.doc: addresses the subject a build event is about.

refs.name: ArtifactRef
refs.doc: addresses a built artifact in the record.

types.name: BuildFinished
types.doc: is the community-floor shape of a finished build. It carries community keys only; a vendor key does not exist from here, and that border is the type system rather than a filter.

deliveries.name: FinishedDelivery
deliveries.doc: is what a FLOOR station is constructed with when a build finishes.
